'Thunder 3' Reveals Production Staff, Additional Cast, First Promo
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Yuuki Ikeda's Thunder 3 manga revealed the production staff, additional cast, key visual (pictured), and main promotional video on Thursday. The anime began airing on July 9 at 12:45 a.m. on Fuji TV's +Ultra programming block and other networks. Manga 'Watashi wo Center ni Suru to Chikaimasu ka?' Gets TV Anime
Production company Bandai Namco Filmworks opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Jun Wakatsuki's Watashi wo Center ni Suru to Chikaimasu ka? (Promise Me the Spotlight) manga on Wednesday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured). Wakatsuki began drawing the idol romance manga in Shounen Magazine Edge in November 2022.
